scope: Read-only verification after Jovi reported an official same-event replay

operator_action.claim: A fresh ordinary-user group event was replayed unchanged through the Feishu developer console.

channel_same_event_replay.reason: The locally available Gateway records do not retain a message_id or event_id for two delivery attempts, and contain no explicit replay or deduplication record.

visible_reply_count.reason: The bot profile's read-only group-history request was denied by its current Feishu permission boundary; no permission change was attempted.

deduplication.reason: One routed user record is compatible with successful deduplication, but does not independently prove that the same Channel event reached the runtime twice.

decision: BLOCKED_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT. Do not create FEISHU_SINGLE_CONSUMER_TEST.json, refresh SHA256SUMS.txt, run P0 Gate, or update PROJECT_STATUS.yaml.
required_next_evidence: A redacted developer-console delivery record proving two deliveries of one message_id/event_id, paired with an independently observable one-route/one-visible-reply count.
